tools.name: list_lab_panels
tools.description: List Picardo’s blood test panels. Each has an ID for get_lab_panel and prepare_order_link, a summary, who it is for, how many tests everyone gets and their subtotal.

tools.name: get_lab_panel
tools.description: Get one Picardo panel: every test it includes, marking any for men only or women only, why the tests were chosen, preparation such as fasting, and the subtotal.

tools.name: search_lab_tests
tools.description: Search Picardo’s orderable Labcorp tests by test name, six-digit Labcorp code or topic word, for example "ferritin", "vitamin D" or "thyroid". Returns each test’s code for prepare_order_link, a short description, price, preparation and the panels that already order it for everyone.

tools.name: prepare_order_link
tools.description: Create a link to review a lab order on picardo.health for the chosen panels and tests. Nothing is ordered or saved here: the user reviews the order, enters their details and pays on the site. Returns the link, what it contains and anything that could not be included.
